newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Inflation data boost Manila stocks at close.
newsitem.headline: Inflation data boost Manila stocks at close.

text.p: Manila stocks rallied at the close on Tuesday on better-than-forecast inflation data and first half corporate earnings, brokers said.
"The good news on inflation doused earlier negative forecast on the market," said Harry Liu, president of Summit Securities.
The composite index was up 36.67 points, or by 1.39 percent, at 2,676.2, but it was off the day's high of 2,681.13 points.
The government reported before the market opened on Tuesday that year-on-year inflation in July was steady at 4.8 percent.
On Monday, a Reuters poll of six financial institutions had forecast July inflation at an average 5.3 percent.

Liberty Telecoms Holdings was in the limelight, soaring 29 centavos, or 42.65 percent, to 92 centavos on a rumour it was talking with a big telecom firm for a joint venture. The issue was the second most traded issue with some 126.4 million pesos changing hands.
Traders said they expected follow-through buying on Wednesday. Jose Maria Ricardo Garcia said he expected the index to find resistance at the 2,700-point level in the next few days.
